item.title: Acton teen held without bail in murders of mother, brother linked to ChatGPT
item.description: An Acton, Massachusetts teenager charged with killing his mother and brother in a case linked to ChatGPT is being held without bail.

item.title: Latest news on ICE plan to give agents electric shock gloves
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement plans to equip its agents with electric-shock gloves manufactured by Compliant Technologies, according to a Department of Homeland Security notice. Critics call the gloves overly aggressive and say they have the potential for abuse. CBS News' Lesley Marin reports.

item.title: $100,000 CD vs. $100,000 high-yield savings account: Which will earn more over the next year?
item.description: Transferring $100,000 into either account type could make sense now. Here's how much interest you'd earn with each.

item.title: Tehran says Strait of Hormuz "under Iran's control" after Trump threat
item.description: Tehran has asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is "under Iran's control and management" after President Trump said the U.S. might "keep it."

item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy trial resumes with State Police investigators testimony
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's trial for the murders of her three children in Massachusetts resumed Thursday with testimony from State Police investigators.

item.title: How much would settling $15,000 in credit card debt cost after fees?
item.description: Settling $15,000 in card debt could reduce what you owe, but the settlement fees will change the math considerably.

item.title: Floodwaters submerge Midwest neighborhoods bracing for more severe storms
item.description: Muddy floodwaters seeped into the homes of Indiana and Ohio residents this week, as severe storms struck the Midwest. Now, some areas are bracing for even more rain.

item.title: Cities propose new tactics to crack down on so-called "teen takeovers"
item.description: Large gatherings of young people, often spurred by online invites, can lead to violence and injuries, even death.

item.title: Social Security tips to save money
item.description: When is the best time to claim your Social Security retirement benefits? CBS News financial analyst Jill Schlesinger breaks it down. (Sponsored by AT&T Business)

item.title: Colombia earthquake death toll nears 300 as rescuers put might into finding survivors
item.description: Rescue and relief efforts are underway in Colombia in the aftermath of a horrific 7.4-magnitude earthquake. CBS News' Lilia Luciano reports from Pereira, Colombia.

item.title: Reese's Halloween pumpkins hit shelves unchanged after lawsuit victory
item.description: Hershey said the Halloween-shaped candy, which had sparked a lawsuit over the product's lack of detail, will return in its familiar oval shape.

item.title: Becky G reflects on how she mixes art with advocacy in her new music
item.description: Singer Becky G was signed to a record label at just 14 years old. She spoke exclusively to "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King about her rise to fame, advocacy in her new music and major collaborations.

item.title: These Trump officials were left behind on Air Force One during president's intense secret plane swap
item.description: Some staffers joined President Trump in covertly swapping planes amid a missile threat from Iran when leaving Turkey. Others were left behind on the decoy plane. CBS News' Aaron Navarro has more.

item.title: Families will on average spend $1,400 on dorm room essentials this year. Here's how to save
item.description: The National Retail Federation estimates students and their parents on average will spend more than $1,400 this year on dorm room essentials. Smart shopping expert Trae Bodge gives money-saving tips for college move-in.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell shares her hormone regimen and why she's taking testosterone
item.description: On "Healthful," Norah O'Donnell speaks with her own doctor, Dr. Rachel Rubin, about her hormone regimen and why she takes testosterone.

item.title: Robert Gilman was on "death's door" before Russia freed him, advocate says
item.description: Robert Gilman, a U.S. Marine veteran, was imprisoned in Russia for over four years and now faces a long road to recovery, says a hostage crisis expert who advocated for Gilman's release.

item.title: Lionel Messi says he has "serious doubts" about soccer future after death of his father
item.description: Just weeks after the World Cup, soccer legend Lionel Messi is talking openly about the possibility of retiring following the death of his father. Nicole Valdes reports.

item.title: Behind the rise of teen takeovers and how some cities are cracking down
item.description: A growing number of U.S. cities are trying to crack down on so-called teen takeovers, when large groups of young people gather in a public place, often in response to online invites. Some of the events have ended with violence and arrests. Mark Strassmann shows how some cities are responding.

item.title: Surrogate gives birth to baby with heart condition despite intended parents seeking abortion
item.description: In Texas, a legal battle is intensifying after a surrogate gave birth to a baby with a severe heart condition. The intended parents in California had wanted to terminate the pregnancy after learning of the diagnosis, but the surrogate refused. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: Is your career "rusting out"? Here's what that means, and how to spot it.
item.description: Many employees feel their employers don't value them and that they're not contributing as much as they could, a workplace poll finds.

item.title: Details emerge about when U.S. learned of potential Iranian plot that led to Trump plane switch
item.description: There are new details about the possible threat from Iran that led to President Trump secretly leaving Air Force One in Turkey last month. Nancy Cordes has more on when U.S. officials first learned of the potential plot and who traveled with the president.

item.title: Democrats pressure Trump administration to rescue 10 other Americans detained in Russia
item.description: Democratic lawmakers are urging the State Department to take measures to secure the release of 10 other Americans detained in Russia following Robert Gilman's release. Kieran L. Ramsey, the chief investigative officer at Global Reach, an organization that assisted with Gilman's release, joins CBS News with more.

item.title: Total solar eclipse dipped parts of Europe into complete darkness. Here's what they saw.
item.description: A total solar eclipse brought darkness to parts of Europe, the only time the phenomenon will be visible to humans in 2026. CBS News' Rob Marciano has more on the stunning moments.

item.title: Single winning ticket sold for $1.04 billion Powerball jackpot
item.description: A single ticket sold in Illinois won the biggest Powerball jackpot of the year, $1.04 billion, in Wednesday night's drawing, the game says.

item.title: Democratic senators demand answers about conditions aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: Senate Democrats are demanding answers about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln during the aircraft carrier's record-setting deployment.

item.title: Police seize 1,000 pounds of cocaine with stickers of soccer star
item.description: Police released a video showing the packages spilling out from the truck's false bottom, with the stickers of Norway's soccer star Erling Haaland.

item.title: Surrogate gives birth to baby at center of multistate legal battle
item.description: Surrogate McKenna West declined to get an abortion requested by the intended parents after the baby she was carrying was diagnosed with a severe but treatable heart defect.

item.title: 2 killed as Apache helicopter from Fort Hood crashes in Salado, Texas
item.description: Two soldiers aboard an AH-64 Apache attack helicopter based out of Fort Hood were killed in a crash on Wednesday, according to local authorities and the Army.

item.title: NYC Council probes prediction markets over advertising practices
item.description: New York City lawmakers allege that four major prediction markets engage in deceptive marketing practices and target young adults.

item.title: Fighter jets intercept civilian plane over Geneva, Ohio
item.description: F-16 fighter jets intercepted a civilian plane that violated a temporary flight restriction over Geneva, Ohio, where President Trump attended the 2026 Patriot Games.
